description:
Data Engineer (SQL / Azure / Power BI)

About the role:
We’re looking for a passionate Junior Data Engineer with SQL, Azure, and Power BI experience to help build and optimize data models and ETL pipelines in Azure.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory.
  • Support data integration, transformation, and loading processes from various data sources.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures.
  • Assist in maintaining and enhancing existing SQL Server Integration Services packages.
  • Contribute to data warehousing and analytics solutions in Azure Synapse Analytics.
  • Monitor data pipelines, troubleshoot issues, and support production environments.
  • Document solutions and follow data engineering best practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields;
  • Strong SQL and relational database skills;
  • Data modeling and KPI understanding;
  • Experience with Power BI or other BI tools;
  • Azure knowledge (Data Factory, Synapse) is a plus;
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.

We offer:

  • Hybrid work model, office near Pipera metro station;
  • Diverse projects using modern technologies;
  • Friendly team and opportunities for growth.

Apply now and let’s build top-notch data solutions together!

At FAN Courier, we believe that a diversity of experiences, perspectives, and ways of working helps us build stronger teams. We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, cultural background, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or age. All employment decisions are made without discrimination, and compensation is fair and equitable for all roles across the company.
